name: NOAA Tides Agent
description: Read-only agent over NOAA CO-OPS tide data: high/low tide predictions, the next high and low, the latest observed water level placed against published flood stages, tide-station lookup by name/state/point, and a watch skill that POSTs to your webhook when the water crosses a height or flood stage. Every answer is read live from NOAA and names the datum. This hosted endpoint answers tide-next, tide-predictions, stations; the local server additionally implements water-level, tide-watch.

skills.name: Next high and low tide
skills.description: The next high tide and the next low tide for a NOAA tide station, with heights.
examples: when is the next high tide at 8518750?

skills.name: Tide predictions
skills.description: Upcoming high and low tides for a NOAA tide station, in station local time, from the current observation forward. Give a seven-digit station id, 'lat,lon' for the nearest station, or a station name.
examples: what are the tides at station 8518750 today?
tide table for the next 3 days near 40.7006,-74.0142

skills.name: Find tide stations
skills.description: Search the NOAA tide-station catalogue by name, by two-letter state code, or by distance from a latitude/longitude point. 3499 tide-prediction stations worldwide (US coasts and territories).

metadata.note: The local Python server implements every skill on its own card, including watch loops and push notifications. This hosted card lists only the skills the hosted endpoint answers.
